basic_info.description: A truly exceptional opportunity at 1980 Vallejo -- a full-floor, remodeled condo in a coveted boutique building. Offering breathtaking, 180-degree views from the Golden Gate Bridge to Russian Hill, this exquisite apartment combines elegant living with modern convenience. The elevator opens directly into an sophisticated foyer, then onto the grand living and dining rooms, complete with a fireplace and sweeping bay views. The renovated chef's kitchen is a culinary dream, featuring quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, wine refrigeration, and high-end stainless steel appliances, including a Wolf induction range and Sub-Zero refrigerator. With four bedrooms, including a versatile den, and three full, renovated bathrooms, this home is bathed in natural light and designed for flexibility and comfort. Additional highlights include in-home laundry room, one designated parking space, and deeded storage. Located on a flat, prime block of Pacific Heights, steps away from the SF's best shops and dining of Fillmore and Union Streets, this residence represents the pinnacle of San Francisco living.
